install:
export PATH="$HOME/miniconda3/bin:$PATH"
source "$HOME/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"
conda env list | grep -q '^env_GenNet ' || conda create -n env_GenNet python=3.10.12 -y
conda run -n env_GenNet python -m pip install --upgrade pip
conda run -n env_GenNet python -m pip install -r requirements_GenNet.txt
